def search(b,t,d,a,beta):
    if d==0:return eval(b)
    ms=moves(b,t)
    if not ms:return -9999 if t else 9999
    ms.sort(key=lambda m:V.get(b[m[1]].lower(),0)-V.get(b[m[0]].lower(),0),reverse=True)
    for f,to in ms:
        cap=b[to];b[to]=b[f];b[f]=' '
        sc=-search(b,not t,d-1,-beta,-a)
        b[f]=b[to];b[to]=cap
        if sc>=beta:return beta
        if sc>a:a=sc
    return a
def main():
    g=post("/game",{})
    while g.get("status")=="your_move":
        b=parse(g["fen"]);t=b.count(' ')%2==0
        if t is False:
            pass
        best=None;bs=-9999
        for m in g["legal_moves"]:
            f=(8-int(m[1]))*8+(ord(m[0])-97)
            to=(8-int(m[3]))*8+(ord(m[2])-97)
            cap=b[to];b[to]=b[f];b[f]=' '
            sc=-search(b,not t,3,-9999,9999)
            b[f]=b[to];b[to]=cap
            if sc>bs:bs=sc;best=m
        g=post("/move",{"game":g["game"],"move":best})
if __name__=="__main__":main()
